name: craft-experience
description: Experience component that turns evidence-backed execution observations into bounded Workflow drafts.

interface.shortDescription: Turn sanitized execution observations into bounded experience drafts.
interface.longDescription: This component ingests only sanitized execution observations and creates a bounded experience draft. It does not publish changes by itself: use Craft Quality and the main Craft runtime for evaluation, signoff, canary, rollback, and routing.
defaultPrompt: Create a bounded Workflow draft from these sanitized execution observations; do not publish it before independent evaluation.
